checks.name: Close policy captures the current tray setting
A new close reads current policy without changing its older snapshot
A real catalog writer precedes the close reader
Close policy acquisition returns to its caller under a held writer
One close owner coalesces duplicate starts
Cancelling the close reader settles before its catalog writer releases
An accepted download decision defers close policy capture
Closing a reader never clears another command's ownership
A close read failure is consumed as an owned result
The close owner can retry after policy failure
Close result publication occurs after releasing Manager
Notification failure cannot undo the captured close result
Repeated close reader cleanup is safe
Policy acquisition never changes settings jobs layout or catalog files
